reviews.text: Super sweet and patient in her care for the dogs 👌

A wonderful first experience at De Brinkie’s Trimsalon! I was nervous about my first visit to a dog grooming salon, but my dog ​​turned out looking absolutely beautiful. You notice right away that they work with a lot of love and attention.

The owner is incredibly sweet, honest about the prices, and absolutely does not try to push unnecessary treatments on you. That felt very pleasant and trustworthy. Additionally, the salon is super clean and tidy.

I will definitely be back here and can highly recommend this grooming salon!

What an amazing woman Lana is! She is not only super professional and good at her job, but above all, she is very warm and sweet! My dog ​​Flo wags her tail and walks out beautifully groomed! Lana also teaches me a lot about Flo's coat and how to care for her. I am very happy with Brinkies!!!
Loyal customer of this grooming salon; Lana is very knowledgeable and very kind to our dog. Very happy with her!
This grooming salon is absolutely fantastic, also for large dogs. Our Bernese Mountain Dog loves going there!
I have been coming here every 3 months for years; my dog ​​is now 15 years old, feels perfectly at ease there, and comes away looking neat and well-groomed every time. …
